positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
September 2021 - April 2025 | Drupal 7 to 10 Upgrade project
Led a phased Drupal upgrade project through intermittent development cycles, leveraging adaptability and deep system expertise to drive it to completion.

August 2023 - June 2024 | Authentication Refactor project
Refactored C# business layer and Drupal portal logic to support a modular authentication flow using configurable identity providers, improving adaptability and security.

August 2022 - December 2022 | ADA Enhancements project
Improved accessibility across the Drupal portal by optimizing color contrast, semantic HTML labeling, and DOM structure in alignment with ADA and WCAG.

December 2021 -  August 2022 | Widget Integration project
Leveraged Okta authentication to integrate reusable, session-aware HTML widgets and responsive Angular components into a Drupal portal.

September 2021 - December 2021 | Drupal Upgrade research project 
Conducted research and requirements gathering to support refactoring of deprecated code in a legacy Drupal 7 system as part of a planned upgrade to Drupal 9.

January 2021 - May 2021 | Security Enhancements 
Improved Drupal portal security and performance by enhancing cookie and header handling, mitigating DDoS risks, and optimizing SOAP API business logic.

March 2020 - June 2020 | Progressive Web App project 
Developed Drupal 7 module logic and supporting SOAP APIs to enable client-branded Progressive Web App installation of a PHP portal on Android, iOS, and Windows devices.

November 2019 - March 2020 | Azure Cloud project
Designed and implemented integration between a Drupal PHP front end, enterprise SOAP APIs, and Azure Cloud Storage, enabling secure, scalable data access.

October 2019 
Sole developer of two high-traffic Drupal PHP portal applications (30,000+ monthly visitors), featuring custom modules, themes, and installation profiles. Integrated with 45+ .NET SOAP APIs and maintained robust test coverage with 1,000+ unit tests using NUnit and Rhino Mocks.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Rhino Mocks · PHP · Drupal · SOAP
